subject: Re: Slipstream bakeoff - request for extra eval credits
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@slipstream.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T16:12:00Z
Subject: Request: additional eval credits for upcoming bakeoff

Hi Ben,

Quick note from the Slipstream side — our internal engineering timeline slipped a week and the other vendor accelerated their integration window. We have a pilot head-to-head scheduled for the week of Nov 8 and the team needs another ~100k tokens to complete the last workload sweep and rerun the ranking tests.

Current trial allocation will run out before we can finish. If Redwood can provide either:
- a one-time 100k token top-up, or
- a 7–10 day trial extension with current allowance preserved

that would put us in a good spot to finish the bakeoff and include Redwood’s results in our procurement notes. We’re still leaning strongly on Redwood for the evaluation given the latency reports in your catalog, but we need this to close the technical side.

Are either of those options possible? Happy to pull in procurement if we need an amendment.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Head of ML Eng, Slipstream AI
elena@slipstream.ai

(attachment: slipstream_topup_request.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@slipstream.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: additional eval credits for upcoming bakeoff

Elena — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the request doc.

We can support the bakeoff, but I need a quick internal approval for discretionary top-ups. Proposed path:
- Redwood provides a one-time 80k-token top-up + a 7-day trial extension (start date aligned with your next run).
- Condition: Slipstream shares a short results summary (one-page) and the run times/queries CSV so we can validate usage and close the loop.

I’m looping in Marissa (pricing) and Karthik (SE) to confirm the discretionary amount and any contractual amendment needed. If that’s acceptable to you I’ll get the DocuSign ready and we’ll push the top-up within 24 hours of signed approval.

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm you accept the 80k + 7-day option or if you need us to escalate for the full 100k.
- Marissa/Karthik: can you confirm approval threshold and required amendment wording?

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0197

(attachment: proposed_topup_terms.pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:14:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: additional eval credits for upcoming bakeoff

Ben — thanks for the context. Approving a one-time discretionary top-up with guardrails. Details below: 

- Approved amount: 75,000 tokens (one-time)
- Extension: 7 days added to current trial window (no stacking beyond that)
- Requirements: signed amendment to capture the one-time credit, and a one-page result summary submitted to Sales Ops within 5 business days of the run.
- Usage cap: If consumption exceeds 75k tokens during the extension, Slack me immediately and we’ll evaluate an additional uplift (requires VP sign-off).

Please record the amendment in HubSpot (deal id DEAL-2026-0897) and attach the signed DocuSign. I’ve attached a stub amendment for Legal to review.

Marissa Cole
Head of Pricing & Promotions, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

(attachment: approved_topup_amendment.docx)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@slipstream.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Slipstream bakeoff - request for extra eval credits

Elena — good news: we’ve approved a one-time 75k token top-up and a 7-day extension. Attached is the amendment for signature and a DocuSign link. Once signed I’ll trigger the top-up and confirm the token balance in your console.

Key points:
- Top-up: 75,000 tokens (one-time)
- Extension: 7 calendar days from the end of your current trial window
- Deliverable: Please send a one-page summary and the run CSV to sales-ops@redwoodinference.com within 5 business days after the final run.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-sl-topup
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/123456789 (DEAL-2026-0897)

Can we schedule a quick 20-minute sync on Monday to align the run timing and any SE support you need? I’ll have Karthik stand by for tuning.

Thanks — looking forward to Slipstream’s results.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0197
